headline: Bring condition, capacity, and readiness evidence into one maintenance decision
capabilities: Analyze IoT sensor data and predict time-to-failure
Automate crew assignments and parts staging for readiness
outcomes: Prevented unplanned downtime and maintained delivery commitments
Reduced emergency repair costs through proactive scheduling
Extended equipment lifespan while sustaining quality standards
Improved production schedule adherence, reducing disruptions
why_try: It makes predictive-maintenance AI concrete: maintenance and production leaders can identify the assets needing attention and review crew, parts, backup, and production-impact considerations together.

sample_prompts.label: Review equipment and technician capacity
sample_prompts.prompt: Give me the equipment and technician-capacity picture I should review before the weekly maintenance meeting.

sample_prompts.label: Find asset signals needing review
sample_prompts.prompt: Which asset signals deserve immediate human review before the next production run?

sample_prompts.label: Draft maintenance candidates safely
sample_prompts.prompt: Draft the maintenance candidates with crew, parts, and backup checks, but do not create or dispatch work orders.

sample_prompts.label: Compare downtime trade-offs
sample_prompts.prompt: What synthetic downtime exposure and preventive trade-offs should leadership review?

business_flow: Maintenance managers, production supervisors, and operations leaders
Azure IoT Hub and approved condition monitoring
Dynamics 365 asset, parts, and work management
